text:
Priya (Product): Heads-up — tomorrow 09:00 PT were doing a staged GA rollout for Unified Toolchain v4 on Hosted API. This bundles streaming, tool-calling, and the new route-level policy engine into a single stable surface. Opt-in for partners first, then rollout to customers over the following weeks. Please read the GA checklist before testing. :sparkles:
Diego (Eng-API): Route: POST /v3/toolchain (stable). Behavior: streaming + tool-calls + per-route policy. Backwards-compatible with v2 streams but has richer event types and structured tool error annotations. No forced migration this week.
Ana (DevEx): Quick try (curl):
```bash
export REDWOOD_KEY=canary_toolv4_ABC
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/toolchain \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"toolchain-medium","input":"Create a 1-line changelog","tools":[{"name":"http_get","args":{"url":"https://httpbin.org/get"}}],"policy":{"quota":"default"}}'
```
Ana (DevEx): JS SDK streaming example:
```js
const s = await client.responses.stream('toolchain-medium', { input:'Hi', tools:[...] });
s.on('event', e => console.log(e.type, e.payload));
```
Release-Bot: [release] toolchain-v4-canary started service=hosted-toolchain region=us-west1 at 2026-09-14T09:00:00Z :rocket:
Maya (SRE): SRE notes: new per-route SLIs are live for /v3/toolchain (p50/p95 latency, tool-exec-duration, structured-error-rate). Canary pages if 5xx > 0.45% for 4m or tool-exec-error-rate > 0.6% for 5m. Add synthetics that exercise multi-tool flows.
Ops-Bot: Default preview quotas: 9 req/s steady, burst 45. If partners need higher throughput for validation, file a request in #ops-requests with org-id + expected qps and window.
Diego (Eng-API): Important: structured tool errors may surface new fields (error.code, error.meta). Clients should ignore unknown fields to stay compatible. If you get tool schema rejections tag @Diego with request_id.
Docs-Bot: Internal GA guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/toolchain-v4-ga (internal only). Migration notes, sample policies and SDK hints are there.
Priya (Product): GA walkthrough + live troubleshooting tomorrow 09:45 PT (30m). RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/toolchain-v4-ga-walkthrough. Drop any odd outputs or regression reports in this thread or bring them to the session. :pray:
